typography.strategy: Soft Utility - Friendly but professional to establish financial trust without feeling overly corporate. Headings must use tight tracking. Body must be highly legible for dense financial data.

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST
colors.notes: CRITICAL: Avoid forbidden color #1B93A4. Used Teal #0D9488 instead for AI/intelligence accents. Navy #0B2447 is the primary trust color. Green #10B981 for positive cash flow. Gold #F59E0B for alerts, warnings, and money accents. Prefer Light theme as default for accessibility among UMKM owners, with dark Navy structural elements for contrast.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows for floating action button and cards. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for main cards, full (pill-shaped) for floating action buttons to feel friendly and modern.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise on the navy hero section to make it feel premium, not flat.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle border (#E2E8F0) on cards to ground them.

layouts.dashboard: Responsive hybrid. Mobile: Navy hero section with Cash Balance and Profit, sticky bottom navigation. Desktop: Collapsible left sidebar, dense multi-column bento grid for KPI cards.
layouts.action_sheet: Dominant Floating '+ RECORD' button on mobile (bottom center) that opens a Shadcn Sheet covering 80vh with a grid of transaction types (Sale, Expense, Purchase, etc.). On desktop, use a standard Dialog modal.
layouts.ai_chat: Chat interface with structured responses (direct answer -> data/evidence -> explanation -> recommendation). Use distinctive message bubbles for K-eM with teal accents.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 for main cards, gap-4 for dense metrics. Use Tailwind spacing scale.

components.navigation: Sticky bottom nav for mobile (Home, Record, K-eM, Reports, More). Fixed header on all screens with Simple/Advanced toggle.
components.cards: Flat white background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default, subtle lift on hover.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. The '+ RECORD' must be massive and highly visible.
components.alerts: Use muted backgrounds (e.g., bg-amber-50) with strong left-border accents to draw attention without clutter.
components.shadcn_customizations: Customize Sheet component for the Record action. Customize Tabs for Simple/Advanced mode. Use Sonner for toasts.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all cards (translate-y-[-2px] with increased shadow). Tap/press states on mobile (scale-95).
motion.stagger: List items (transactions, alerts) should animate in with staggered delay using framer-motion.

media.mascot: Since local assets in /tmp/mascot/extracted may be missing, mock the 'K-eM' mascot using lucide-react 'Bot' icon combined with emotion states (Smile, AlertTriangle, Zap, Frown) or generate a simple CSS/SVG wallet-robot shape.

image_urls.description: Indonesian warung owner to establish immediate empathy and connection during onboarding or empty states.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Navy background with White text is high contrast. Teal/Gold accents must be legible against their backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='record-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main Dashboard layouts to allow asymmetrical/creative placement.
Use Shadcn for interactive logic (Sheet for '+ RECORD', Tabs for mode toggle, Dialog for alerts).
Build a mobile-first UI but ensure it scales gracefully to desktop (sidebar + grid layout).
For the AI Chat (K-eM), implement a custom message UI where responses are distinctly structured in 4 parts: Direct Answer, Data Evidence, Explanation, Recommendation.
Integrate a 'Continue with Google' button as the sole auth mechanism (emergent login flow).
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Import and use 'Plus Jakarta Sans'.
For icons, install and use lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react. Do not use emojis.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use proper SVG icons.
Use pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container text (no .App { text-align: center }). Maintain human natural reading flow.
